title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_die_din_en_iso_9001_2015_verstehen_by_simone_brugger_gebhardt_dg4ii (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_die_din_en_iso_9001_2015_verstehen_by_simone_brugger_gebhardt_dg4ii' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be considered exposed and require immediate rotation from a different, clean computer. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee full remediation due to potential persistent malicious software.
